units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 9. A participant that has submitted a procurement application may withdraw it in accordance with paragraphs 10 and 11 of this Article:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) before the deadline for submitting procurement applications;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) from the posting, under this Federal Law, of the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection in the unified information system until the posting, under Article 51(2) of this Federal Law, of the draft contract to be concluded with that participant, except where the application has been rejected (in electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures). Applications assigned the first three ranks under this Federal Law may not be withdrawn.
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 10. To withdraw an application in an electronic procedure or closed electronic procedure, the participant:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) shall prepare a withdrawal using the electronic platform or specialized electronic platform and sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) in the case specified in paragraph 9(1) of this Article, the application is deemed withdrawn upon signing the withdrawal in accordance with point 1 of this paragraph;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3) in the case specified in paragraph 9(2) of this Article, the electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator shall, no later than one hour after the withdrawal is signed under point 1 of this paragraph, send it to the contracting authority in the unified information system, indicating the application identification number and the entry number in the unified register of procurement participants for the participant that prepared the withdrawal. The application is deemed withdrawn when the withdrawal is sent in accordance with this point.
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 11. In a closed tender or closed auction, the participant shall send the withdrawal of its application to the contracting authority. The application is deemed withdrawn when the contracting authority receives the withdrawal.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Application to participate in procurement
units.text: 12. The procurement participant is responsible for the inaccuracy of information and/or documents included in its application and for actions performed on the basis of that information and/or those documents.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.label: Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1. In competitive procurement methods, the contracting authority must require security for procurement applications. It may waive this requirement if the initial (maximum) contract price does not exceed one million roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2. In accordance with this Federal Law, procurement application security shall be set at the following amounts:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) if the initial (maximum) contract price does not exceed twenty million roubles, from one half of one per cent to one per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) if the initial (maximum) contract price exceeds twenty million roubles, from one half of one per cent to five per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3. Enterprises of the penal correction system and organizations of persons with disabilities specified in Article 29(2) of this Federal Law shall provide application security, where required by the contracting authority, of one half of one per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price. State and municipal institutions shall not provide security for the procurement applications they submit.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 4. A participant may provide application security in cash or by an independent guarantee provided for in Article 45 of this Federal Law. The participant chooses the form of security independently. The independent guarantee must remain valid for at least one month from the application deadline.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 5. In electronic procedures:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) application security shall be provided in one of the following ways:
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: а) by blocking funds in a bank account opened by the participant at a bank included in the list maintained by the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system and published on that body’s official website on the Internet (hereinafter, a special account), for transfer in the cases provided for by this Article to the account in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation, or to the relevant budget of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish requirements for such banks, special account agreements and the procedure for using an existing bank account of a procurement participant as a special account;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: б) by providing an independent guarantee meeting the requirements of Article 45 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) to submit a procurement application, the participant shall select the form of security on the electronic platform by specifying either the special account details or the entry number from the register of independent guarantees posted in the unified information system;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3) where application security is provided in cash:
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: а) submission of the application signifies the participant’s consent to blocking funds in its special account in the amount of the application security;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: б) no later than ten minutes after receiving an application submitted before the application deadline, the electronic platform operator shall send the bank holding the special account information on the account details and the amount required as application security;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: в) no later than forty minutes after receiving the information specified in subpoint “б” of this point, the bank shall block funds in the special account in the amount of the application security and inform the electronic platform operator of the blocking. If the special account does not contain that amount in unblocked funds, the bank shall not block the funds and shall, within the same period, inform the operator that the account lacks the amount required as application security;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: г) if the bank reports insufficient funds in the special account to secure the procurement application, the electronic platform operator shall return the application to the participant under Article 43(6)(5)(е) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 4) where application security is provided by an independent guarantee, the electronic platform operator shall, by interacting with the register of independent guarantees posted in the unified information system and no later than one hour after receiving the application, verify the presence of the registration entry number in that register, the amount of the guarantee, and whether the procurement identification code in the guarantee matches that in the procurement notice. The electronic platform operator shall return the application to the participant in accordance with Article 43(6)(5)(ж) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 6. Where circumstances are identified showing that a bank not included in the list provided for in paragraph 5(1)(а) of this Article meets the established requirements, or that a listed bank no longer meets them, the Central Bank of the Russian Federation shall send that information to the federal executive body regulating the contractual procurement system within five days of identifying those circumstances, so that the list can be amended accordingly.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 7. Each electronic platform operator shall conclude a cooperation agreement with every bank included in the list provided for in paragraph 5(1)(а) of this Article. The Government of the Russian Federation shall determine the requirements for the terms of those agreements. Interaction between the electronic platform operator and the bank under this Article shall be electronic.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 8. A bank may open special accounts for procurement participants only after concluding cooperation agreements with every electronic platform operator. Funds in a participant’s special account may secure only that participant’s procurement applications. The bank shall block and release funds in the special account for application security on the basis of information received from the electronic platform operator under this Article. Funds blocked under this Article may not be seized to satisfy the participant’s obligations. The bank shall pay interest for the use of funds held in the special account, including while they are blocked as application security. The interest rate shall be determined by the special account agreement concluded by the participant.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 9. The rules governing use of the special account must provide for the bank to carry out the following transactions on the basis of information received from the electronic platform operator:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) blocking and releasing funds in accordance with this Article. Blocking restricts the participant’s right to dispose at its discretion of funds in its special account in the amount securing the relevant application for the period provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) transferring, in the cases provided for by this Article, blocked funds in the amount securing the relevant application:
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: а) to the account in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 9 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: б) to the relevant budget of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 9 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 10. The electronic platform operator shall send the bank the special account details needed for the bank to perform a transaction under paragraph 9 of this Article within one hour of any of the following events:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) rejection of a procurement application (except in the case provided for in paragraph 13 of this Article), or exclusion of a participant from supplier (contractor, service provider) selection under this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) withdrawal of the application by the participant under this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3) conclusion of a contract with a procurement participant under this Federal Law. In this case, the electronic platform operator shall also send the special account details of all participants whose applications have not been rejected or withdrawn and who have not been excluded under this Federal Law, except participants deemed under this Federal Law to have evaded conclusion of the contract;
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 4) cancellation of procurement under Article 36 of this Federal Law. In this case, the electronic platform operator shall send the special account details of all participants that submitted procurement applications;
units.label: Point 4 Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 5) receipt of a decision of the procurement oversight body refusing approval of a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider);
units.label: Point 5 Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 6) receipt of a decision provided for by this Federal Law refusing to enter information on the participant in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers) in connection with its evasion of conclusion of the contract;
units.label: Point 6 Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 7) entry of information on the participant in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers) under Article 104 of this Federal Law in connection with its evasion of conclusion of the contract.
units.label: Point 7 Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 11. No later than one hour after receiving the information specified in paragraph 10(1)–(6) of this Article, the bank shall release the funds blocked under paragraph 5(3)(в) of this Article in the special account or accounts whose details were sent by the electronic platform operator, and inform the operator of the release. No later than one hour after receiving the information specified in paragraph 10(7) of this Article, the bank shall transfer the funds blocked under paragraph 5(3)(в) of this Article to the account in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation, and inform the electronic platform operator of the transfer.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 12. In the cases specified in paragraph 10(1)–(6) of this Article, the contracting authority shall not return an independent guarantee provided as application security to the person or guarantor that provided it, and no claim shall be made under it. In the case specified in paragraph 10(7) of this Article, the contracting authority shall demand payment under the independent guarantee provided as application security by the participant whose information was entered in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers) because it evaded conclusion of the contract.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 13. If, in electronic procedures within one quarter of a calendar year on one electronic platform, procurement commissions find three or more applications from the same participant non-compliant with the procurement notice on the grounds specified in Article 48(12)(1)–(3) and (5)–(9) of this Federal Law, the funds blocked in that participant’s special account in the amount securing every third such application shall be transferred to the relevant budget of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation under paragraph 14 of this Article, or payment shall be demanded under the independent guarantee securing every third such application in the procedure provided for in paragraph 15 of this Article.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 14. If, in the case provided for in paragraph 13 of this Article, security for the third procurement application was provided in cash:
units.label: Part 14 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) fifteen working days from the day following the posting on the electronic platform, in respect of that application, of the record specified in Article 48(17), Article 49(5)(2) or Article 50(3)(2) of this Federal Law, the electronic platform operator shall send the bank the special account details of the participant that submitted the application, unless the operator has received a decision of a court or procurement oversight body finding that the decision on that application does not comply with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 14 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) no later than one hour after receiving the information specified in point 1 of this paragraph, the bank shall transfer the funds blocked in the participant’s special account in the amount securing that application to the relevant budget of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation and inform the electronic platform operator of the transfer;
units.label: Point 2 Part 14 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3) no later than one hour after receiving from the bank the transfer information specified in point 2 of this paragraph, the electronic platform operator shall inform the participant of the transfer.
units.label: Point 3 Part 14 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 15. If, in the case provided for in paragraph 13 of this Article, security for the third procurement application was provided by an independent guarantee:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) fifteen working days from the day following the posting on the electronic platform, in respect of that application, of the record specified in Article 48(17), Article 49(5)(2) or Article 50(3)(2) of this Federal Law, the electronic platform operator shall send the contracting authority that posted the relevant record information on the occurrence of the case specified in paragraph 13 of this Article and on the participant that submitted the application, unless the operator has received a decision of a court or procurement oversight body finding that the decision on that application does not comply with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) no later than three working days from the day following receipt of the information specified in point 1 of this paragraph, the contracting authority shall demand payment under the independent guarantee provided by that participant.
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 16. In a closed tender or closed auction:
units.label: Part 16 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 1) participants shall deposit application security funds in the account specified by the contracting authority in the procurement documentation, in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 16 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 2) a participant shall be deemed not to have provided application security if the funds whose deposit as application security is evidenced by information and documents (or copies) in the application have not reached, before the date of examination or examination and evaluation of applications, the account specified in the procurement documentation in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 16 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 3) the contracting authority shall return funds deposited as application security no later than five working days from the day following the occurrence of any case specified in paragraph 10(1)–(6) of this Article. The funds shall not be returned to the participant in the case specified in paragraph 10(7) of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 16 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 4) where a participant provides application security by an independent guarantee, the contracting authority shall examine that guarantee in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 4 Part 16 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 17. In closed electronic procedures, the provisions of this Federal Law governing application security in electronic procedures shall apply, unless otherwise established by the Government of the Russian Federation under Article 24(13)(2) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Security for an application to participate in procurement
units.text: 18. The Government of the Russian Federation may establish specific rules for the procedure by which foreign procurement participants provide application security.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.label: Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1. Contracting authorities shall accept, as security for applications, contract performance and warranty obligations, independent guarantees issued by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 1) banks meeting the requirements established by the Government of the Russian Federation and included in the list provided for in paragraph 1.2 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Terms of an independent guarantee. Registers of independent guarantees
units.text: 2) the State Development Corporation VEB.RF;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 45
